games.name: Toilet Tiggy (Stuck in the Mud)
games.summary: A fast tag game where frozen players are freed when a teammate crawls through their legs.
games.setup: Mark a clear area. Pick 1–2 taggers (more for bigger groups).
games.howToPlay: Taggers chase everyone. A tagged player freezes standing with legs apart. To free them, another player crawls through their legs (and mimes a 'flush').
rules: You can't be tagged while crawling to free someone.
variations: Add more taggers to raise the challenge.

programAdaptations.disability: Walking-only taggers, bigger personal space, high-five unfreeze.
programAdaptations.homeschool: Great in a backyard/park with 1 tagger.
programAdaptations.oshc: Big-group energy burner — set clear boundaries.

games.name: Grandma's Footsteps
games.summary: Players sneak up on Grandma and freeze whenever she turns around.
games.setup: One player ('Grandma') stands at one end facing the wall. Everyone else lines up at the far end.
games.howToPlay: Players creep forward while Grandma's back is turned. When Grandma spins around, everyone must freeze. Anyone caught moving goes back to the start. First to tag Grandma wins and becomes the new Grandma.
rules: Move only when Grandma is looking away.
Caught moving = back to the start line.
variations: Freeze in a circus shape each time.
safety: Spread players out to avoid bumping.

programAdaptations.disability: Shorten the distance; allow a support partner.
programAdaptations.homeschool: Perfect for small groups or siblings.
programAdaptations.oshc: Good settle-down game after high energy.

games.name: What's the Time Mr Wolf
games.summary: Players take steps toward the Wolf until he calls 'Dinner time!' and chases them home.
games.setup: Wolf stands at one end facing away. Players line up at the other end.
games.howToPlay: Players chant 'What's the time, Mr Wolf?'. The Wolf calls a number ('3 o'clock') and players take that many steps forward. When the Wolf calls 'Dinner time!' he turns and chases everyone back to the start line. Anyone tagged becomes the next Wolf.
rules: Take exactly the number of steps called.
Tagged players become (or help) the Wolf.
variations: Circus steps: cartwheel-steps, bunny-hops, giant leaps.
safety: Watch for collisions on the run home.

programAdaptations.disability: Wolf walks; allow wheels/walkers; shorter run.

games.name: Circus Relay Race
games.summary: Teams race through circus skill stations in a relay.
games.setup: Set up stations along a course at 5m / 10m / 15m distances. Split into even teams.
games.howToPlay: Each player runs the course completing a skill at each station, then tags the next teammate. Possible stations: star jumps, forward rolls, hula hoop spins, beanbag balance, juggling challenge, shuttle runs.
rules: Complete each station before moving on.
Tag the next runner to start them.
variations: Pairs run together for younger kids.
safety: Space lanes so teams don't collide.

programAdaptations.disability: Choose-your-station relay; seated skill options.

games.name: Musical Hula Hoops
games.summary: Musical-chairs with hoops — jump into a hoop when the music stops.
games.setup: Scatter hoops around the space (one per player to start). Have music ready.
games.howToPlay: Players move around the hoops while music plays. When it stops, everyone jumps into a hoop. Remove a hoop each round. If two players land in the same hoop, they play Rock Paper Scissors — winner stays, loser does 10 star jumps and rejoins.
rules: One player per hoop after each round.
Settle ties with Rock Paper Scissors.
variations: Move like circus animals between rounds.
Team hoops — fit the whole team in shrinking hoops.
safety: No diving for hoops — feet first.

programAdaptations.disability: No elimination; everyone always has a hoop.

games.name: Animal Races
games.summary: Race across the floor using different animal movements.
games.setup: Mark a start and finish line.
games.howToPlay: Coach calls an animal movement and players race across: frog jumps, crab walk, bear crawl, bunny hops, kangaroo jumps, seal slides.
rules: Race to the line and back.
variations: Mix two animals in one length.
safety: Soft surface for crawls and slides.

programAdaptations.disability: Pick movements that suit each child; no racing pressure.

games.name: Circus Obstacle Course
games.summary: A multi-skill course combining circus and gym stations.
games.setup: Build a flowing course: forward roll → beam walk → hula hoop jumps → tunnel crawl → juggling station.
games.howToPlay: Players move through the course in order, completing each obstacle before the next.
rules: One person per obstacle for safety.
variations: Add a memory element — repeat the sequence.

programAdaptations.disability: Optional/seated stations; lower the beam to the floor.

games.name: Ninja Warrior Challenge
games.summary: A timed obstacle course — fastest clean run wins.
games.setup: Build a challenging obstacle course and set a clear start/finish.
games.howToPlay: Players run the course one at a time and are timed. Fastest clean completion wins. Penalties for skipped obstacles.
rules: One runner on the course at a time.

programAdaptations.disability: Personal-best focus, adapted obstacles, no clock pressure.

games.name: Shape Freeze
games.summary: Move to music, then freeze in a called gymnastics shape.
games.setup: Spread players out with personal space.
games.howToPlay: Players move around. The coach calls a shape and everyone freezes in it: star, tuck, straddle, pike, arabesque, handstand.
rules: Hold the shape still for 3 seconds.
Correct shape required to stay in.
variations: Hold for longer to build strength.

programAdaptations.disability: Seated/supported shapes; pick achievable shapes.

games.name: Circus Simon Says
games.summary: Simon Says using circus and gymnastics movements.
games.setup: Players spread out facing the coach.
games.howToPlay: Players only perform a movement when the coach says 'Simon says…'. Use circus/gym moves: 'Simon says do a star jump / juggle / balance on one leg / strike a clown pose'.
rules: Move without it = sit out one round (or do a fun forfeit).
variations: No-elimination: forfeit a silly pose instead.

programAdaptations.disability: Slow pace; visual cues; no elimination.
programAdaptations.oshc: Reliable filler that calms or lifts energy.

games.name: Pirate Treasure Hunt
games.summary: Collect 'treasure' from around the room using a chosen movement.
games.setup: Scatter 'treasure' across the room. Give each player or team a hoop nest.
games.howToPlay: Players collect treasure back to their nest one piece at a time, moving in the called style (crab walk, bear crawl, hopping).
rules: One piece of treasure per trip.

programAdaptations.disability: Closer treasure; any movement allowed.

games.name: Human Hungry Hippos
games.summary: Lie on a scooter board while a partner launches you to grab beanbags.
games.setup: Pile beanbags in a centre hoop. Players lie on scooter boards around the edge; a partner holds their feet.
games.howToPlay: On 'go', the partner pushes the player toward the centre to grab ONE beanbag, then pulls them back. Most beanbags at the end wins.
rules: Hold partner's feet — no letting go fast.
safety: Smooth floor, no fingers under boards.

programAdaptations.disability: Seated reach version; gentle pace.

games.name: Balloon Keepy Uppy
games.summary: Keep a balloon off the floor — solo or as a team.
games.setup: One balloon per player or per small team.
games.howToPlay: Players keep the balloon in the air without it touching the floor. Count the streak.
variations: Team circle — everyone touches once before a repeat.

programAdaptations.disability: Slow balloon = accessible for most abilities; seated works.

games.name: Circus Traffic Lights
games.summary: Colour calls trigger circus movements — listen and react fast.
games.setup: Teach the colour commands first.
games.howToPlay: Coach calls colours and players respond: Green = run, Yellow = walk, Red = freeze, Purple = spin, Blue = balance, Orange = forward roll.
rules: Last to react does a fun forfeit (no elimination).

programAdaptations.disability: Fewer commands; visual colour cards.
programAdaptations.oshc: Energy up or down on demand.

games.name: Magic Freeze
games.summary: Dance/move, then freeze as a called circus character.
games.setup: Spread out with space to pose.
games.howToPlay: Players move freely. On 'freeze!', the coach names a character and everyone strikes that pose: lion, clown, tightrope walker, magician, robot, superhero.
rules: Be creative — there's no wrong pose.
variations: Add a sound/action for each character.

programAdaptations.disability: Seated character poses welcome.

games.name: Volcano Tag
games.summary: The floor is lava — tagged players become erupting volcanoes.
games.setup: Place mats and equipment as safe zones. Choose 1–2 taggers.
games.howToPlay: Players move around avoiding taggers. Stepping on the 'lava' floor or being tagged turns you into a stationary 'volcano' who can tag passers-by. Safe zones (mats/equipment) can't be camped on.
rules: No camping in safe zones (5-second limit).
Volcanoes stay put but can tag.

programAdaptations.disability: More/closer safe zones; walking taggers.

games.name: Star Collector
games.summary: Earn stars by completing circus and gym challenges.
games.setup: Set up challenge stations, each worth a star token.
games.howToPlay: Players move between stations completing challenges (forward roll, balance challenge, juggling challenge) and collect a star for each. Ties to BSC's real Star reward system.
rules: Earn a star by completing the challenge well.
variations: Bonus 'effort stars' for trying something new.

programAdaptations.disability: Personalised challenges so everyone earns stars.
programAdaptations.homeschool: Pairs with a home star chart.

games.name: Steal the Egg
games.summary: Collect then steal 'eggs' between nests — most eggs wins.
games.setup: Pile all eggs in the centre hoop. Each player has their own hoop nest spread around the room.
games.howToPlay: Round 1: players collect eggs from the centre to their nest, one at a time. Round 2: once the centre is empty, players steal eggs from other nests, one at a time. Player with the most eggs when the coach calls time wins.
rules: No grabbing an egg from someone's hands.

programAdaptations.disability: Closer nests; any movement; no-steal collect-only version.
programAdaptations.oshc: Reliable big hit — supervise the chaos.

games.name: Floor Is Lava
games.summary: Cross the room on islands without touching the 'lava' floor.
games.setup: Lay out mats, hoops and blocks as 'islands' across the floor.
games.howToPlay: Players move island to island without touching the floor. The coach can call events: 'Lava rising', 'Earthquake', 'Volcano eruption', 'Freeze'. Advanced: remove islands as the game goes on.
variations: Carry an object without dropping it.

programAdaptations.disability: Wider/closer islands; pathway version.

games.name: Handstand Heist
games.summary: One partner holds a strength shape while the other ferries props — a BSC original.
games.setup: Two students per team. Set a hoop at each end of each team's lane.
games.howToPlay: One student holds a strength shape (handstand, wall sit, plank, or balance shape). The other transports juggling balls or scarves from one hoop to the other. When the load is moved, partners switch roles. If the held shape drops, the transport partner must freeze until the shape resumes.
rules: Transport stops whenever the shape drops.
Switch roles after each completed load.

programAdaptations.disability: Use plank/wall-sit/seated holds; flexible roles.
programAdaptations.homeschool: Needs a partner and mat space.

games.name: Circus Delivery Race
games.summary: Transport circus props to the matching coloured hoops, fast.
games.setup: Place coloured hoops around the room. Pile matching coloured props at the start.
games.howToPlay: Players deliver each prop to its correct coloured hoop, one at a time, racing the clock or another team.
variations: Memory version — colours called, not shown.

programAdaptations.disability: Closer hoops; fewer colours.

games.name: Clean Your Room
games.summary: Two teams throw beanbags onto each other's side — cleanest side wins.
games.setup: Split the room in two with a centre line. Scatter beanbags on both sides.
games.howToPlay: On 'go', each team throws beanbags onto the other team's side to keep their own side clean. On 'stop', count beanbags — the side with the fewest wins.
safety: Throw at the floor, not people.

programAdaptations.disability: Closer line; rolling instead of throwing.

games.name: Circus Builders
games.summary: Teams build a pyramid, castle or circus tent from equipment.
games.setup: Give each team a set of equipment and a build challenge.
games.howToPlay: Teams design and build a structure (pyramid, castle or circus tent) using available equipment and safe low acro shapes. Judge on teamwork, creativity and stability.
safety: No high human pyramids without coaching + mats.

programAdaptations.disability: Equipment-only builds; clear roles.

games.name: Superhero Rescue
games.summary: Complete circus challenges to 'rescue' a trapped superhero.
games.setup: Place the 'superhero' (mascot/toy) at the end of a challenge path.
games.howToPlay: Players complete circus challenges in sequence — forward roll, balance beam, hula hoop jump, bear crawl — to reach and rescue the superhero.

programAdaptations.disability: Adapt/choose challenges; full support to succeed.

games.name: Traffic Jam
games.summary: Move through hoop pathways responding to motion commands.
games.setup: Lay hoops in winding pathways across the floor.
games.howToPlay: Players travel along the hoop pathways. The coach calls a motion style and everyone changes: slow motion, fast forward, reverse, freeze.
rules: No bumping the car in front.

programAdaptations.disability: Wider pathways; fewer commands.
programAdaptations.homeschool: Tape lines work instead of hoops.
